messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Saving Map  in "CSV" format
parts:
There's a function map2table() for converting the map into a table.
Then use write.csv() to save it to a CSV file.
Here's an example:

library(qtl)
data(hyper)
map <- pull.map(hyper)
tab <- map2table(map)
write.csv(tab, "map.csv")

karl
